rationale: C16 provides a concrete and material template for the child: nearly the same enumerated tax-return categories, an order opening returns to inspection by a Senate committee for a specified investigative purpose, and the same condition tying inspection to a Treasury decision approved that date. The child adapts this machinery to particular tax years, the Senate Committee on Expenditures or its subcommittee, and the tanker-sale investigation. C10 is also a strong inspection-order analogue and supplies the child's nearly verbatim Federal Register effectiveness clause, but its inspecting body, covered returns, and purpose are less closely aligned. C20 shares the basic tax-return inspection formula but fewer distinctive elements.

shared_material.child_excerpt: any income, excess-profits, declared value excess-profits, capital stock, estate, or gift tax return for the years 1945 to 1950, inclusive
shared_material.parent_excerpt: any income, excess profits, declared value excess-profits, capital stock, estate, and gift tax returns for any period to and including 1949
shared_material.explanation: The unusually detailed enumeration of tax-return categories is substantially identical, with only minor grammatical and date-range changes.

shared_material.child_excerpt: shall ... be open to inspection by the Senate Committee on Expenditures in the Executive Departments or the duly authorized subcommittee thereof for the purpose of investigating
shared_material.parent_excerpt: shall be open to inspection by the Special Committee established pursuant to Senate Resolution 202 ... for the purpose of carrying out the provisions of the said Senate Resolution
shared_material.explanation: Both use the same operative mechanism to authorize a Senate committee's inspection of tax returns for a defined congressional investigation.

shared_material.child_excerpt: subject to the conditions stated in the Treasury decision relating to the inspection of such returns by that committee, approved by me this date
shared_material.parent_excerpt: subject to the conditions stated in the Treasury decision relating to the inspection of such returns by that Committee, approved by me this date
shared_material.explanation: This condition is virtually verbatim and is a distinctive part of the shared administrative machinery.
